item.title: Parent One-Pager
item.description:
This one-page handout turns the curriculum presentation into a format that is easier to print, email, or share with new families.

It includes:

  • the purpose of the program
  • a quick summary of all five levels
  • what parents should expect
  • simple ways to support Kannada at home
